name: ev-study-watch-reader
description: Read-only: lets E.V. Home read your latest school note, E.V.'s context file and your Study Watch session files from Documents/E.V. Study Watch.
long_description: E.V. Home, opened in the Claude desktop app, uses this to read context.json (written by E.V.'s evening run), live/latest.json (your latest NUR 112 or BIO 201 note, written by Study Watch in reader mode) and the session files in sessions/, so it can file your sessions the moment you open it. It cannot write or delete, reads nothing else, returns a session as its findings (never the note text or cards), skips notes and sessions tagged #graded, and never returns Journal, personal or E.V. folders.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Whether the folder is reachable, when context.json was written, and which note Study Watch saved last (no note text).

tools.name: latest_note
tools.description: Your latest NUR 112 or BIO 201 note's plain text with its title and line, or unchanged:true when nothing new was written.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: Your Study Watch session files: id, size, hash and modified time (no contents).

tools.name: read_session
tools.description: One session's findings as E.V. files them (summary, weak spots, connections, note to-dos), never the note text.
